input.question: q-C-02
input.text: Who can approve an exception to the identification requirements?

clauses.text: Only a manager can approve an exception to the identification requirements.
clauses.title: Customer Identification Policy

clauses.text: Only the branch manager can approve an exception to the identification requirements.
clauses.title: Deposit Account Opening Policy

clauses.text: Only the operations specialist can approve an exception to the identification requirements.

clauses.title: Opening a Small Business Account

clauses.text: A regional manager can approve a rate exception as large as 0.50%.
clauses.title: Documenting Pricing Exceptions
